title: Awaken by Hippocrates: An Evening of Awakening, Renewal and Community
content:
Overview
Awaken by Hippocrates invites you to an inspiring twilight evening of connection, wellness, renewal, and meaningful community
Sunset Experience – Immerse yourself in an evening of renewal, connection, and inspiration. Welcome & Connection – Meet our team and fellow attendees in a warm, welcoming environment. Wigmore Coconut Experience – Discover the legacy of Ann Wigmore through a unique hands-on experience. Guided Campus Tour – Explore our 55-acre wellness sanctuary and healing spaces. Fire & Ice Breathwork – Energize and awaken your senses through guided breathwork and refreshing elements. (Bring a bathing suit.) Nourishing Plant-Based Dinner – Enjoy a wholesome meal and homemade ice cream inspired by the Hippocrates lifestyle. Tea Ceremony & Meditation – Slow down, reflect, and reconnect through mindfulness and guided meditation. Closing Fire Ceremony & Bonfire – Gather under the stars for reflection, inspiration, and meaningful connection. Exclusive First-Time Guest Experience – Created especially for those beginning their wellness journey with Hippocrates. Leave feeling renewed, inspired, and connected—with practical tools to support a healthier, more vibrant life.
